technique.summary: Submit unexpected fields in API requests that get automatically bound to internal object properties. This can modify fields like role, isAdmin, balance, or verified that should not be user-controllable.
steps: Identify an API endpoint that accepts JSON/form data for object creation or update
Study the normal request to understand expected fields
Review API responses, documentation, or error messages for hidden/internal field names
Add additional fields to the request: role, isAdmin, admin, verified, balance, permissions
Check if the extra fields were persisted by reading the object back
Attempt privilege escalation by setting role=admin or isAdmin=true

payloads.notes: Add role field to registration request
Add boolean privilege fields to profile update
Modify pricing fields in order/transaction endpoint

bypassTechniques: Try different cases: Role, ROLE, isadmin, is_admin
Use PUT/PATCH methods which may have different binding rules than POST
